page.layout: One printed page, two columns of Hebrew word entries separated by a vertical rule. Left column: entries from the top, then a letter heading (ל) mid-column, then entries to the foot. Right column: continues from the left column's last line, with entries to the foot. Running heads at top left and top centre-right (ל), page number top right. Catchword and signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: יֵאָתֵרוּ[?] atteretur, יִכָּתְנוּ[?] contendentur, pro יוּכַּח[?], יוּכָתוּ[?], fut. Hoph. 3. sing. & pl. mafc. Rad. פָּתַח[?]
יִכָּתֵבֶן[?] scribentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad כָּתַב[?]
וַיִּכָּתוּם[?] & contriverunt eos, Num. 14. 45. pro וַיִּכְיָתוּם[?], fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. פָּתַת[?]
וַיִּלְאוּ[?] et defessi sunt, fut. Kal, וַיִּלְאוּךָ[?] & defatigarunt te, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. לָאָה[?]
יִלָּבֵב[?] cordatus fiet, & יִלָּבֵט[?] conturbatus fiet, fut Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. לָבַב[?], & לָבַט[?]
יָלַד generabit, יָלְדוּ generarunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. parag. Rad. יָלַד
יָלֵד gignens, יֹלֶדֶת pariens, Ben. Kal, f. m. &
וַיֶּלֶד & genuit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָלַד[?]
וַיּוֹלְדָה[?] & paries, præt. Kal, comp. cum Ben. Kal, sing. fæm. vel, est præt. Poel, 2. f. fæm. R. יָלַד
יָלַדְתָּנִי[?] peperisti, (pro יָלַדְתָּ[?]) me, יָלַדְתָּנוּ[?] nos, præt. Kal, 2. f. fæm. aff. Rad. יָלַד
יָלַדְתִּיךְ[?] genui, peperi te, יָלַדְתִּיהוּ[?] illum, præt. Kal, 1. f. aff. Rad. יָלַד
יָלְדַתְנִי[?] peperit me, יָלַדְתֶּךָ[?] te, יָלַדְתָּהוּ[?] eum, (pro יָלַדְתָּהוּ[?],) præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. aff. Rad. יָלַד
יִלְוֶה[?] adjunget se, וַיִּלְוּ[?] & adjungent se, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָוָה
יִלְוֶךָּ[?] mutuabit tibi, יִלְוֻנּוּ[?] ei, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. לָוָה
וַיִּלּוּנוּ[?] & murmurarunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants are read from a low-resolution scan and are doubtful; each uncertain Hebrew word is marked [?]. The printed "mafc." is a printing error for "masc." and is left as printed. The page number "157" is read from a small top-right mark and is marked [?]. The running head ל is a letter, treated as a running head. The left column ends mid-entry ("f. m. &") and the right column opens with "fæm.", so the entry runs across the column break. The letter ל at mid-left is a section letter, written as a paragraph.
